description: Presidential Secretariat - Order made under Sec. 8(1) of Payment Devices Frauds Act, No. 30 of 2006 to appoint Mr. K. G. P. Sirikumara and 04 others and Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Response Team (SLCERT) as the Institution, to the Panel of Experts
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Payment Devices Frauds Act, No. 30 of 2006, which involves the appointment of persons to a Panel of Experts and the rescinding of a previous order. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it pertains to the implementation and modification of existing legislation (a specific Act) and the establishment of a regulatory framework for payment device fraud prevention. While it mentions the President and appoints individuals, the core content is about legal/regulatory action rather than government personnel or structural changes.
